title: Rhythm feedback
idea: Rhythm feedback: Timing cues and feedback align with a readable play lane
audience: People who need to play rhythm within a game surface.
avoidWhen: Visual cues do not match audio timing
distinctFrom: Differs from a generic instrument layout through its play rhythm priority and explicit commitment contract: Judgement derives from measured gameplay timing
navigation: Rhythm feedback keeps the current play rhythm context visible; secondary detail has an explicit return path.

composition.entry: Timing cues and feedback align with a readable play lane
composition.continuation: Continue with the evidence and controls needed to play rhythm; timing is the core interaction
composition.priority: Judgement derives from measured gameplay timing

imagery.role: Support the actual play rhythm context; essential controls and state remain native.

brandConstraints: Preserve approved identity, semantic roles and licensed assets.
Treat font and palette suggestions as optional; do not replace fixed branding.
responsiveRules: Offer redundant cues and input calibration per device
Compose for safe zones, aspect ratio and the actual input device; preserve world readability.

stateContracts.loading: Keep the rhythm feedback structure stable while authoritative content resolves; expose unavailable action state.
stateContracts.empty: Explain why no play rhythm content is available and offer a relevant next action.
stateContracts.failure: Preserve safe context and identify the failed operation; Judgement derives from measured gameplay timing
stateContracts.offline: Label cached/unsynchronized play rhythm content and prevent claims of server completion.
stateContracts.success: Judgement derives from measured gameplay timing
stateContracts.interruption: Restore the active play rhythm context safely after navigation, focus loss or platform interruption; do not replay committed actions.

accessibilityRisks: Do not communicate state through color alone; name controls and expose current selection.
Verify reading order, input alternatives, enlarged text and focus restoration for this composition.

performanceBudget.principle: Set an explicit project budget from the actual content/device; no unsupported universal frame or bundle promise.
performanceBudget.verify: Measure frame-time and input latency in the real engine; DOM checks cannot certify in-world UI.

reviewNotes: Original authored candidate; no representative render, independent craft review or task evaluation is attached. Structural validation is not visual validation.
